notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.6 - Slave: a TCP slave now serves several masters at the same time (up to 16), for example SCADA and a test tool, or two Poll instances. Before, a second master's connection was accepted but its requests timed out until the first master disconnected. One master disconnecting no longer affects the others.
